method: All formal runs retained. Original phases use HTTP/1.1 localhost:3200; applied phases are supplemental mobile-only DevTools throttling. Focused completion trials have one cold mobile run per route (two routes, except compact-native-h2 has four). baseline-h2 has three cold mobile runs per route; final-h2 has three cold mobile/desktop runs per route. HTTP/2 phases use the same loopback-only HTTPS proxy at localhost:3443 on the same host, with a disposable local certificate exception only in owned headless Chrome profiles. Production original requests were h2. Budgets, Lighthouse default simulation and CPU/network configuration are unchanged; compare only within method/transport. Local evidence is not final production verification.
